description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19,999. Grants [Crystal Force Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode: Bartz (Fire/Water/Wind/Earth)] to user. Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking]/[Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Earth with Stacking] based on if entry damage was Fire/Water/Wind/Earth.

description.name: Crystal Force I
description.text: Six single attacks (2.00 each) capped at 19,999. Grants [Instant Cast 1], [Instant ATB 1], [Crystal Force Chase Mode: Bartz] to user. Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking]/[Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Earth with Stacking] to user based on Command entry damage.

description.name: Crystal Force II
description.text: Six single attacks (2.00 each) capped at 19,999. Grants [Dualcast Fire, Water, Wind, Earth 2], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 2], [200% ATB 1] to user.

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Bartz (Fire/Water/Wind/Earth)
description.text: Fire/Water/Wind/Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire/Water/Wind/Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode

description.name: DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)
description.text: Ignores 25% of the target's DEF and RES

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3
